query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants) as total_plants,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_terroirs) as total_links,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plant_id) FROM plant_terroirs) as plants_with_terroir;
